title: S7 'actually flying from Tokyo, not London' — LIVE NL intake + RECORD replacement corridor + honest authority ceiling

boundaries.note: natural-language departure-origin correction interpreted by LIVE Model Studio into the frozen ChangeRequest schema (departureOrigin external ref), zod-validated
replacement-corridor planning evidence through the RECORD-mode Atlas adapter; sanitized recordings persisted

steps.description: Traveller corrects the departure gateway in natural language; LIVE Model Studio extracts the declared origin into the frozen schema

body.text: Heads up — my plans changed: I am actually flying out of HND to Singapore, not London. The rest of the trip stays the same.

assert.description: the NL correction is accepted
the request came from interpretation, not a pre-structured target
a declared departure-gateway substitution maps to a transport schedule change
a recovery case opens for the correction
the declared gateway is recorded verbatim — resolution never silently rewrites the traveller's declaration

assert.expected: the arrival corridor must be re-planned from the declared gateway
assert.description: the old London-origin corridor is obsolete: re-planning from the declared gateway is the recorded consequence

steps.description: Planning loop re-searches the arrival corridor FROM the declared Tokyo gateway (RECORD Atlas evidence) on the leg's own departure date and proposes substitution strategies

assert.description: the planner requests replacement-corridor evidence first, then proposes from it
the evidence request is a flight search on the replacement corridor
the RECORD Atlas adapter supplied replacement-corridor offers from the declared gateway
normalized replacement offers become candidate strategies

assert.expected: Rebook to fly from the declared departure gateway
assert.description: the candidate rebooks the existing arrival leg with the substituted origin — the superseded London origin is never re-proposed
a same-day arrival from the declared gateway satisfies the programme arrival constraints
a feasible replacement exists, so the engine ranks a best strategy instead of failing closed
the return corridor consequence is recorded, never assumed away

assert.expected: the return leg departing the event gateway still terminates at the superseded origin
assert.description: explicit uncertainty preserved: the return's replacement terminus is unverified and not rebooked on assumption
the case advanced through the planning stage

steps.description: The best substitution strategy becomes a money-moving intent; deterministic authority reviews it

assert.description: the strategy was staged as a validated action intent
honest authority ceiling: RECORD fails closed on SGD-limit vs USD-spend incomparability (ADR-045); REPLAY blocks on the curated SGD ceilings
a blocked intent is never executable
the blocked money-moving intent escalates the case for human review
the blocking spend-ceiling rule is named in the deterministic rule trace in both modes

steps.description: Observe the recovery case after the authority stage

assert.description: the case belongs to the requesting traveller's trip
the evaluated options remain visible on the case
